evidence_tier: P0 exploratory transport / source-qualified relational test

source.paper: Kizilirmak et al. 2023, Small transcriptional differences among cell clones lead to distinct NF-kB dynamics

transport_question: Does the previously observed genome-wide pre-stimulus chi_GRI correspondence with later NF-kB dynamics survive a mechanistically distinct IL-1beta input, and does the source-native IL-1beta circuit again refuse or support scalar collapse?

A_genomewide.formula: chi_GRI = sample_sd(source-published log2 RPKM)/(2*mean(source-published log2 RPKM))
A_genomewide.clone_summary: median gene-wise chi_GRI over common eligible genome-wide genes

B_IL1B_circuit.source_basis: IL-1R3 limiting receptor plus NF-kB p65, IkBa feedback, and A20 feedback species in the source IL-1beta/NF-kB model
B_IL1B_circuit.clone_summary: median of four frozen gene-wise chi_GRI values
B_IL1B_circuit.leave_one_gene_out: diagnostic only, never a replacement B

native_dynamic_gate.primary_endpoint: source-reproducible fraction of cells with >=2 peaks under published smoothing/prominence rule
native_dynamic_gate.persistence_endpoint: median AUC, with source-expected B greater than R and G if reproduced
native_dynamic_gate.early_activation: descriptive source control only; expected B approximately G greater than R; not used to rescue the primary oscillation gate
native_dynamic_gate.failure_rule: if R>B primary oscillatory ordering fails, stop transport interpretation; if G>B fails, record partial transport rather than retune

claim_ceiling.allowed_if_positive: exploratory transport evidence that pre-stimulus historical RNA fluctuation structure carries information about later NF-kB dynamical phenotype across two distinct inflammatory inputs in this source
forbidden: chi_GRI is a physical damping ratio
chi=1 is a biological critical boundary
